name: Claude Code

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: 'Issue number to fix'
        required: true
        type: number
      instructions:
        description: 'Optional additional instructions for Claude'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: read

jobs:
  claude-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    concurrency:
      group: claude-code-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: false

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check if user is a collaborator
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Check if the triggering actor is a collaborator
          if ! gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/collaborators/${{ github.actor }} &>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::User ${{ github.actor }} is not a collaborator and cannot run this workflow."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "User ${{ github.actor }} is a collaborator. Proceeding."

      - name: Get Issue Details
        id: issue
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const issue = await github.rest.issues.get({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
            });
            core.setOutput('title', issue.data.title);
            core.setOutput('body', issue.data.body);
            core.setOutput('html_url', issue.data.html_url);

      - name: Run Claude Code
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are an expert developer working on the liam-hq/liam repository.
            
            Context:
            - Issue Number: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
            - Issue Title: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.title }}
            - Issue Body: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.body }}
            - Issue URL: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.html_url }}
            
            Instructions:
            ${{ inputs.instructions }}
            
            Please analyze the issue and implement the necessary fixes.
            Ensure all changes are properly tested and documented.
            Commit your changes with a descriptive message referencing the issue number.
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514
          timeout_minutes: 25

      - name: Create Draft Pull Request
        if: steps.claude.outputs.conclusion == 'success'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          title: "fix: resolve issue #${{ inputs.issue_number }} - ${{ steps.issue.outputs.title }}"
          body: |
            ## Description
            
            This PR resolves issue #${{ inputs.issue_number }}.
            
            ### Changes
            - Implemented fix for: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.title }}
            
            ### Related Issue
            - Fixes #${{ inputs.issue_number }}
            
            ### Notes
            - This is an automated PR created by Claude Code.
            - Please review carefully before merging.
          branch: "claude/fix-issue-${{ inputs.issue_number }}"
          delete-branch: true
          draft: true
          labels: |
            claude-code
            automated-pr
          assignees: ${{ github.actor }}
